## Summary
Parker, you're showing a solid upward trend in your metrics over the past week, particularly with your hours per RO averaging around 1.28. Your customer satisfaction index (CSI) has remained consistently high at 943, indicating great service delivery. Keep up the momentum!

## What's Working
- Your average hours per RO have improved to 1.28 as of May 30, which is above the industry average for Hyundai dealerships. This demonstrates your ability to maximize labor hours effectively. 📈
- The alignment upsell percentage is strong, with a high of 34.6% on May 20. This suggests you're effectively communicating the value of alignments to customers.
- Your tire upsell is also commendable, peaking at 13.6% on May 30. This indicates you're capitalizing on opportunities to recommend necessary services. 🔥
- The ELR (Effective Labor Rate) has remained above 90% consistently, with a high of 90.9% on May 30, showing that you're pricing services competitively and effectively.
- You've managed to maintain a CSI of 943 for multiple days, reflecting positively on your customer interactions. Keep nurturing those relationships! 👏

## Where to Focus
- The RO counts have shown variability, peaking at 224 on May 30 but dropping to 157 on May 22. Consistency in bringing in ROs is crucial for overall productivity. Aim to maintain a steady flow of appointments each day. A concrete step could be to follow up on leads or service reminders. 
- The ROH50 (Revenue per Hour) is low at 0.99 on May 30. This indicates that while you're bringing in hours, you may not be maximizing revenue opportunities. Focus on upselling additional services during customer interactions. 
- Your Valvoline upsell has fluctuated, hitting a low of 28.3% on May 15. Consider revisiting how you present oil change options to customers, emphasizing the importance of high-quality products. 
- The number of open ROs is concerning, particularly RO 777735, which is 9 days old. Ensure you're following up with techs to expedite resolution and keep customers informed. Timely communication will enhance customer satisfaction.

## Action Items for This Week
1. Follow up on open RO 777735 to ensure timely completion and customer communication regarding the no-crank issue.
2. Aim to increase your RO counts by reaching out to at least 10 customers due for service reminders this week.
3. Develop a strategy to improve your Valvoline upsell percentage by at least 5% by the end of the week, possibly by creating a script or checklist for service conversations.

## Open Work to Push
- Focus on following up with RO 777902, which is 2 days old and requires customer communication regarding the alternator and battery replacement. Additionally, keep an eye on RO 777876, which is 3 days old, to ensure timely updates to the customer.
